cohort: 115 mother-infant dyads, consisting of preterm infants weighing less than 1800g admitted to a neonatal unit of a KMC reference center, grouped by whether they received Kangaroo-Mother Care.
finding: Kangaroo-Mother Care was associated with a 23 times higher likelihood of exclusive breastfeeding at discharge and a 19% reduction in hospital length-of-stay compared to the non-KMC group.
